notes: Event date: 5 February 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 4 p. 72-75: the 78th Division (Maj. Gen. Edwin P. notes: Event date: 9 February 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 4 p. 81-82: at 1800 on 9 February the 1st Battalion, 309th Infantry, passed through the 311th Infantry and headed for the dam; by midnight the engineers had entered the inspection tunnel; the Germans had already destroyed the machinery and discharge valves).
